Telo.Application/SourceLinksApp: source 'loops' entry 'native/loop/self': link target 'self' resolves to the link itself.

Telo.Application/SourceLinksApp: source 'cross' entry 'native/darwin/libx.so': the link ships in the native napi (darwin/arm64) layer, but its target 'native/linux/libx.so.1' ships in the native napi (linux/amd64) layer. A runtime extracts only the layers it needs, so the link would dangle — point it at a file of its own layer.

Telo.Application/SourceLinksApp: source 'loops' entry 'native/loop/missing': link target 'nowhere' resolves, relative to the link's directory, to 'native/loop/nowhere', which is not another entry of this source.

Telo.Application/SourceLinksApp: source 'loops' entry 'native/loop/outside': link target '../../../x' resolves, relative to the link's directory, to a path outside the module, which is not another entry of this source.
